name: Munir Morad
story: Munir Morad, also known as Munro Morad, studied geography, completed a PhD in London and began lecturing at Trinity College in Carmarthen, Wales. In a recorded career interview he describes his subsequent role as professor of environmental planning and head of the Department of Urban Environment and Leisure Studies at London South Bank University. The interview documents his work in teaching, research and departmental leadership but does not give a complete dated employment history.

Duane Wilkins recalls Morad teaching GIS at the University of Waikato in early 1997 and introducing him to KeyCad. The Waikato connection and the alternate name Munro Morad come from Wilkins’s direct recollection, recorded for this publication in October 2026. They are kept distinct from the institutional career account.
